meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回溯历史对话,找到之前怎么解决的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 记得之前聊过的需求和方案
copy.tagline_en: Search past conversations to recall how you solved it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with AI over many sessions and need it to remember earlier context.

howto.what: 用户问到过往会话时，Claude 会在跨会话记忆库中搜索，先返回带编号和标题的索引列表，对感兴趣的结果查看时间线上下文，最后只对筛选出的编号批量获取完整详情，不会直接拉取全部记录。
howto.when: 当用户问“这件事之前解决过吗”“上次是怎么做的”等涉及以前会话的问题时触发。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修复登录问题的？
say.note: 返回带标题的记录表，供你筛选。

say.text: 之前有没有讨论过认证方案？
say.note: 会给出相关话题的时间线上下文。

say.text: 帮我查上周关于数据库的改动。
say.note: 按日期搜索后批量取详情。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about past session work, Claude searches the persistent memory index with IDs first, then views a timeline for context, then batch-fetches full records only for filtered IDs, avoiding full pulls up front.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks whether something was already solved, how something was done last time, or otherwise needs work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login issue last time?
say_en.note: Returns a list of matching entry titles to pick from.

say_en.text: Have we discussed the authentication approach before?
say_en.note: Shows timeline context for the relevant records.

say_en.text: Find database changes from last week.
say_en.note: Searches by date, then fetches details for picked items.
